title: Action beats Perfection
transcript: You might try to achieve perfection, find that perfect best move. But actually, by spending too much time, you will start running into time trouble. And so, I think that an important takeaway is that action beats perfection. Playing a move good enough to keep you in the game is [music] more important than finding the right move. And if you train this skill enough, you might get used to doing [music] this in your life as well. Because you see, if you play a bad game, you might lose the game. But if you don't play a move [music] because you're looking for that one perfect way of winning the game, >> [music] >> you are going to lose the game for sure. And I just think that that's something to think about.
